verdict.rationale: A state employment agency could plausibly publish an API for tasks like quarterly wage filing, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: the eServices/EAMS web portal behind a SecureAccess Washington login, mail, email and fax. Every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404, and no documented public API appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
